killedBy: entities: mines under reduced motion states the fuse as a monotone brightness, not a strobe
why: Restores the accelerating strobe for a player who asked for reduced motion. It is the one cue in this issue whose rate climbs -- 1.67 Hz mean over the strobing phase, peaking at 3.333 Hz at the moment the warning window takes over -- and the brightness that replaces it carries the same fuse progress from a single frame.
